name: Guai Cai Julebu 2
source:
You were a miss in the manor, but an accident completely disrupted the trajectory of your life... When the whole world is falling, where do you go in the face of the terrible truth and the unknown future?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428460/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你原本是莊園裡的大小姐，一場變故卻將你的人生軌跡徹底打亂……當整個世界不斷墮落，面對可怕的真相與未知的前路，你又該何去何從？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428460/]Steam[/url]]
